c_star_coverage.exemption: RC-06: continuous control, fails AD-1, governed by the declared runtime-safety layer
RC-06: continuous control, fails AD-1, governed by the declared runtime-safety layer

policy_metadata.runtime_acceptance_condition: A conformant consuming runtime loads only bundles verifying as signed Phi outputs (signature, payload hash, lifecycle-registry state), accepts no policy content through any other channel, and emits decision receipts carrying the requirement reference of every evaluated predicate.

predicates.decision_semantics: PERMIT requires the triple to be absent from the approved contraindication table; indeterminate or absent evidence fails.
predicates.evidence_semantics: A versioned IFU contraindication table lookup over (procedure_class, instrument_class, task).
predicates.subject: assistance_module
predicates.warrant_boundary: Establishes the triple is not on the approved contraindication list. It does not establish trajectory or force safety.

predicates.decision_semantics: PERMIT requires the boundary digest to equal the authorization digest; a mismatch is HOLD (INV-STATE-BINDING), never a silent permit.
predicates.evidence_semantics: A world-state digest computed over (procedure_step, instrument_id, port_configuration) at authorization and recomputed at the boundary.
predicates.subject: assistance_module
predicates.warrant_boundary: Establishes the world state has not changed since authorization. It does not establish the delivered energy is clinically appropriate.

predicates.decision_semantics: PERMIT requires an authenticated, privileged, token-holding supervisor in SUPERVISED mode; indeterminate or absent evidence fails.
predicates.evidence_semantics: A signed control-token artifact reporting the authenticated supervisor, procedure-class privileging, token ownership, and autonomy mode.
predicates.subject: assistance_module
predicates.warrant_boundary: Establishes an identifiable supervising surgeon holds authority for this subtask. It does not establish the surgeon is attentive (see C-16).

predicates.decision_semantics: PERMIT requires 2-of-2 concurrence within the declared window; expiry with fewer than 2 attestations is DENY, never a timeout.
predicates.evidence_semantics: A signed console-attestation artifact reporting distinct releasing and receiving actor attestations.
predicates.subject: assistance_module
predicates.warrant_boundary: Establishes both parties attested to the transfer. It does not establish either party reviewed the handoff substantively.

predicates.decision_semantics: PERMIT requires no effective ActorScopeRevocation covers this actor and action tuple at authorization time.
predicates.evidence_semantics: A signed registry lookup reporting whether the proposing actor's scope over this action tuple has been revoked (auxiliary check A1).
predicates.subject: assistance_module
predicates.warrant_boundary: Establishes the actor's scope was not revoked. It does not establish the actor was ever competent to hold it.

predicates.decision_semantics: PERMIT requires the guidance class to be absent from the contraindication table for this procedure class, on a non-stale snapshot.
predicates.evidence_semantics: A structural check that the guidance class is not contraindicated for this procedure class and the context snapshot is not stale.
predicates.subject: assistance_module
predicates.warrant_boundary: Establishes the presented guidance is not contraindicated by class. It does not establish the guidance content is clinically correct.

predicates.decision_semantics: PERMIT requires the signed consent artifact to cover the proposed export tuple; indeterminate or absent evidence fails.
predicates.evidence_semantics: A signed consent artifact covering (data_class, destination, purpose), attested by the circulating nurse.
predicates.subject: assistance_module
predicates.warrant_boundary: Establishes the export is within the recorded consent scope. It does not establish the consent itself was properly obtained.

predicates.decision_semantics: PERMIT requires the model id to resolve in the validated-models registry for this procedure class at the bound model version.
predicates.evidence_semantics: A signed model-registry lookup reporting whether the consulted model is validated for this procedure class and matches M.version_binding.
predicates.subject: assistance_module
predicates.warrant_boundary: Establishes the model was validated for this use. It does not establish the model's output is clinically correct.

predicates.decision_semantics: A dwell outside the approved band raises an advisory monitoring signal; it does not itself deny authorization.
predicates.evidence_semantics: Deterministic telemetry proxy for substantive review: per-step attestation dwell time for pre-authorized step classes.
predicates.subject: assistance_module
predicates.warrant_boundary: Establishes a proxy for review substance. It does not establish the surgeon's attention was actually engaged.

predicates.decision_semantics: PERMIT requires strict containment on every component and inequality on at least one; an identical or wider child is DENY.
predicates.evidence_semantics: A signed delegation-registry check that the child permit's (scope, validity, actions) is strictly contained in its parent's (auxiliary check A3, INV-DELEGATION-NARROWING).
predicates.subject: assistance_module
predicates.warrant_boundary: Establishes the child permit narrows its parent. It does not establish the parent permit itself was properly authorized.

predicates.decision_semantics: PERMIT requires patient_id == scheduled patient, snapshot within its declared freshness bound, and a verified lineage chain.
predicates.evidence_semantics: A signed context-snapshot artifact reporting patient-identity match, freshness, and an unbroken lineage hash chain.
predicates.subject: assistance_module
predicates.warrant_boundary: Establishes the snapshot's identity, freshness and lineage. It propagates to C-03 via input_provenance; it does not itself establish the autonomous proposal is clinically correct.

predicates.decision_semantics: Expiry of the bound is HOLD (on_evaluation_timeout), never a partial permit; this is the governance row over INV-LATENCY, as R-11/B-06 sit over their coinciding invariants.
predicates.evidence_semantics: An independent deadline watchdog, outside the evaluator it supervises, reporting whether evaluation completed within evaluation_latency_bound.
predicates.subject: assistance_module
predicates.warrant_boundary: Establishes the evaluator signaled completion in time. It does not establish the evaluation's substantive correctness.

predicates.decision_semantics: A missing correlation places HOLD on the next ordinary authorization in the affected scope (POST_EVENT_AUDIT); it never gates the intervention itself.
predicates.evidence_semantics: A signed safety-event registry check (auxiliary check A2) that every declared safety-layer intervention is correlated to a SafetyEvent within its recording window.
predicates.subject: assistance_module
predicates.warrant_boundary: Establishes recovery evidence completeness. It does not establish the safety layer's own correctness or certification.

predicates.decision_semantics: PERMIT requires the proposed tuple and parameters to resolve exactly to an approved matrix row. Indeterminate or absent evidence fails.
predicates.evidence_semantics: A signed lookup artifact reporting whether the proposed action tuple and its bound parameters are present in the approved authority matrix at the stated matrix version.
predicates.subject: assistance_module
predicates.warrant_boundary: Establishes closure of the proposed action against the approved matrix. It does not establish that the matrix itself is correctly scoped -- that is a governance judgment recorded in S.

predicates.decision_semantics: PERMIT requires authorization_time <= evidence_commit_time < actuation_time, with the receipt chained to its predecessor.
predicates.evidence_semantics: A signed evidence-chain artifact carrying the authorization, commit and actuation instants for this decision.
predicates.subject: assistance_module
predicates.warrant_boundary: Establishes the temporal ordering and chaining of the evidence record. It does not establish the truth of the receipt's content, nor that the trusted time source is honest.

predicates.decision_semantics: PERMIT requires the runtime fingerprint to equal M.version_binding.fingerprint. Indeterminate or absent evidence fails.
predicates.evidence_semantics: A signed deployment attestation reporting the configuration actually loaded at authorization time.
predicates.subject: assistance_module
predicates.warrant_boundary: Establishes that the running configuration is the assessed configuration. It does not establish that the assessed configuration is safe. This is the per-action form of the version-drift argument: no action is authorized under a configuration the assessment never covered.
